card.name: Capital D starting a new word
card.fires_on: The letter D or d (or Dis) that begins a drug name or term right after a comma, colon or 'of' in drug-label lists. The word is split so the D stands alone before the rest.

modes.label: Drug name after comma
modes.description: A lone d begins a drug name in a list of interacting drugs.

modes.label: Drug name after of or before
modes.description: A lone d begins a drug name after a phrase like 'dose of' or 'initiating'.
modes.example: The recommended dose of<< d>>actinomycin for injection, as

modes.label: Capital D in headings or abbreviations
modes.description: A capital D begins a heading word or abbreviation such as Dose or DPD.
modes.example: Nadir After Prior<< D>>ose Dose Adjustment Leukocytes (/

card.plain: It fires on the first letter D when a drug name or heading word starts with D and is split into pieces.
